versions.changelog:
Initial release of content-creator-bundle:

- Integrates multi-platform content rewriting, scheduled publishing, analytics, and comment interaction management for self-media creators.
- Enables one-click adaptation and publishing of a single article to 10+ platforms with tailored style and format.
- Provides YAML-based configuration templates for platforms, content calendars, rewrite rules, and publishing schedules.
- Offers best-practice examples and workflow guides for cross-platform operation, trending topic analysis, and smart comment management.
- One-time purchase, lifetime use; significantly reduces manual workload for content creation and distribution.
